title: Pointer arithmetic walk
brief: Array ko pointer arithmetic se traverse karo aur offsets print karo.
objective: p+i aur element size ka relation
solution:

title: Safe string copy
brief: snprintf se bounded copy karo aur truncation print karo.
solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){char b[6];snprintf(b,sizeof b,"%s","hello world");printf("%s\n",b);return 0;}

title: Text records
brief: Teen records text file me likho aur wapas padho.
solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){FILE *f=fopen("/tmp/r.txt","w");for(int i=1;i<=3;i++)fprintf(f,"%d:%c\n",i,'A'+i-1);fclose(f);f=fopen("/tmp/r.txt","r");char l[32];while(fgets(l,sizeof l,f))printf("%s",l);fclose(f);return 0;}

title: Hash-ish frequency
brief: Array me element frequency count karo.
solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int a[]={2,3,2},n=3;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int c=0,seen=0;for(int k=0;k<i;k++)if(a[k]==a[i])seen=1;if(seen)continue;for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if(a[j]==a[i])c++;printf("%d:%d ",a[i],c);}printf("\n");return 0;}
